items.headline: ALB: An Undervalued Lithium Play with a Bright Future
items.snippet: Net debt to adjusted EBITDA has fallen from 3.5x to 0.5x since end-2024; quarterly capex down from $342.8M to $71.7M. Recommendation: Buy ALB.

items.headline: Fitch Upgrades Albemarle Corporation's Ratings to 'BBB'; Outlook Stable
items.snippet: Albemarle's asset base includes high-grade, long-life brine and spodumene resources supporting a favorable cost position. Fitch expects healthy lithium demand to support cash flow; industry overcapacity remains a key risk to lithium prices.

items.headline: Albemarle has surprising new reason to rally
items.snippet: Mizuho raised its 2027 lithium demand estimate by almost 10% on stationary battery storage, giving Albemarle a second demand source beyond EVs. Lithium remains a commodity and supply could revert to surplus.

items.headline: Albemarle Corporation(ALB) Zacks Company Report
items.snippet: Zacks Underperform view: weaker Energy Storage volumes, falling lithium prices and rising supply-chain costs; 2026 Energy Storage volume guidance 225-235kt vs 235kt in 2025; $70-90M unmitigated cost impact from Middle East disruptions.

items.headline: Albemarle upgraded to Outperform from Neutral at Mizuho
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle to Outperform from Neutral (PT $130). Strong BESS demand tipped the market balance; 2027 Energy Storage price forecast raised to $21k from $17k.
